question: Does a full-layer action-sender K/V donor replacement bidirectionally change selection at this fixed root, while the same replacement at the equal-size current-proprio sender does neither?
scope: One post-hoc known root; a different sending edge from the failed direct text-entry gate. Researcher activation diagnostic, not a native attack, new independent harm, deployable defense or reopening of the failed30-root gate.
original_goal: open the top drawer and put the bowl inside
forecast_goal_swap: put the bowl on top of the cabinet
model_precision: Native bfloat16 model and text; native float32 sampling latents; no precision or backend change.
resource_policy: Check free memory before loading. Do not modify any other process. An unavailable resource, OOM, timeout or technical error ends this attempt as deferred or invalid, not as a negative scientific result. No automatic retry, offload, CPU fallback or reduced model budget.
activity_accounting: Four baseline Future/Value pairs also capture frame1/frame4 donor K/V; two identity donor pairs; eight experimental pairs.14 Future+14 Value, one denoiser forward each, exactly one self-attention invocation per layer per Future. No extra attention forwards. Native model/tokenizer once each; discard unused VAE.

cache_inputs.candidates: clean_candidate0.pt and clean_candidate1.pt: action_latent, normalized_actions, environment_actions, future_latent, value_latent, value, seed
cache_inputs.swap_calibration: swap_candidate0.pt and swap_candidate1.pt: action_latent, future_latent, value_latent, value, seed
cache_inputs.real_future: truth_candidate0_input.pt and truth_candidate1_input.pt: jointly encoded real-future value_input with trusted prefix0:5 and actual-future slots5:8
cache_inputs.noise: noise_seed31.pt and noise_seed32.pt: cached unit_noise; native seeded generation must match the saved noise exactly
cache_inputs.rule: Use only these existing tensors and historical utility records. No Action regeneration, new text encoding, new endpoint encoding or physical replay. Check shape, dtype, finiteness and candidate/seed mapping before model calls. Preserve the source artifacts unchanged.

native_source_contract.flatten_order: b t h w d -> b (t h w) d
native_source_contract.module_hook: model.blocks[i].self_attn.compute_attention for every block, only during Future; q,k,v are native normalized/positioned outputs
native_source_contract.shape_gate: Assert the actual patch sizes, grid, block count and full input/output shape before applying slices. Reject an unexpected layout rather than inferring another frame or broadcasting.
native_source_contract.qkv_shape: [1,1764,n_heads,head_dim], n_heads*head_dim=2048; exact actual shape, dtype and device must match donor

intervention.permission: Researcher internal activation access; no deployed attacker privilege or defense claim.
intervention.capture: Unmodified baseline runs capture clones of post-norm/post-RoPE K and V for frames1 and4 at all28 layers, keyed by background,candidate,layer. Save CPU donor tensors. Return original Q,K,V to unchanged native attention. No actual future supplied to donor.
intervention.operation: For each Future self-attention call, clone current recipient K and V; replace exactly196 target rows with the corresponding other-Goal baseline donor at the same candidate, seed and layer. Pass the identical Q object and cloned K/V to native attention, retaining native attention/output projection/residual gates.
intervention.not_a_trajectory_clamp: Non-target K/V retain the current hybrid recipient computation, not frozen baseline Swap/Clean values. Later layers may propagate effects normally. The replacement does not alter raw actions or all Goal paths.
intervention.selection: All28 layers, all heads, complete frame4 action or frame1 current-proprio, strength1, one native denoiser call per sampler. Unexpected multiple calls invalidates rather than adapting.
intervention.copy_and_integrity: Assert no Q mutation, no native K/V mutation, non-target copied rows exact, donor target rows exact, eval/no dropout/no cache/no context parallelism, full9x14x14 layout and finite Q/K/V.
intervention.randomness: Same cached per-candidate noise seeds31/32; copy/capture hooks consume no CPU/CUDA RNG. No resets inside layers.
intervention.value_is_protected: Remove all hooks before every Value call. Value always uses original_text, n_cond8 and its unchanged candidate seed. A Future output slot8 difference is not supplied as Value conditioning; slots0:8 are the actual consumed prefix.
intervention.prefix_gate: All Future outputs must preserve the cached candidate action/current prefix0:5 bitwise under native sampling. Original normalized and environment action arrays remain exactly unchanged.
intervention.matched_control: Same196-token full-layer K/V replacement at current-proprio frame1; matches structural operation, not delta norm, semantic information or sensitivity. Record per-layer K and V delta norms without rescaling.

execution_order: clean candidate0, clean candidate1, swap candidate0, swap candidate1; passive capture of frame1/frame4 K/V and full initial-layer QKV, then exact baseline and initial-layer checks
same-Goal no-op clean candidate0 frame4, same-Goal no-op swap candidate1 frame1; validate both before experimental calls

calibration.baselines: Require exact equality of all four regenerated Future tensors, Value tensors and scalar Values against cached Clean/Swap records. Check the cached input/noise equality and native selections. Baseline results are retained and reused, not rerun.
calibration.no_op_gate: Same-background donor replacement must reproduce cached full Future and Value tensors and scalar exactly, with zero K/V deltas. Captured baseline tensors must themselves exactly match references. Both noops pass before experimental arms.
calibration.failure: Stop on first failed equality, nonfinite tensor, missing/multiple layer invocation, wrong donor mapping, cache/context-parallel path, mutation, hook leak, RNG perturbation or resource limit. Preserve invalid/deferred partial record; do not widen tolerances or rerun scientific arms.
calibration.initial_layer: Require full baseline layer0 Q/K/V identical across Clean/Swap for each candidate; self-attention precedes the first text cross-attention. Every experimental layer0 donor delta must be zero.
calibration.baseline_action_binding: Clean and Swap full action_latent exact; candidate seed31/32 exact; native action decoding equals saved Clean normalized_actions. Prior calibrated Clean/Swap environment-control checks must both be true. Swap cache intentionally does not duplicate raw action arrays.

analysis.selection: Higher native Value wins. Exact ties choose candidate0 as in the native max(range(2), key=...) implementation, but a tie never satisfies a strict direction gate.
analysis.baseline_gate: Strict clean selection1 and strict swap selection0, plus all calibration checks passed.
analysis.forecast_error: For each candidate and condition, report native visual-latent MSE over future wrist/primary slots6:8 versus its cached joint real-future value_input. Report future proprio separately if using the already verified native extraction. These are encoded real-consequence errors, not physical-state MSE or task utility. Forecast error is secondary and is not an additional post-result gate.
analysis.required_rows: Both Values, signed Value1-minus-Value0 margin, strict ordering/ties, selected index, per-candidate forecast errors, selected historical branch utility, hook call counts and separate K/V selected-row delta statistics for all six conditions. Keep no-op/calibration rows distinct.

historical_utility.boundary: These are previously measured full original-Goal continuations after forcing the selected first16 controls. This experiment does not newly execute a chosen action or establish recovery of the continuously swapped closed loop. The two branches share one root and are not independent root samples.

analysis.if_gate_passes: Support local bidirectional action sender dependence relative to the registered proprio location control. Not unique action semantics, complete causal mediation, physical-content attribution, native external privilege, deployable defense, broad novelty or population generalization.
analysis.if_gate_fails: NO-GO for action-specific bidirectional selection under this registered sender replacement. Preserve one-way and continuous effects without upgrading the gate. Close this diagnostic; no layer/head/token/strength/seed/root/candidate/Goal/Value search or full panel to rescue. Retain old direct-entry failure and30-root failed expansion gate.
analysis.continuous_descriptive: m=Value1-Value0; G=mClean-mSwap>0; repair movement R_X=(mSwap_X_Clean-mSwap)/G; injection movement I_X=(mClean-mClean_X_Swap)/G for X=action,proprio. Report raw margins and action-control differences. Do not clamp, label as mediation/recovery percentages or substitute these for the strict primary gate.

interpretation_limits: This intervention changes internal sending edges; Clean donor includes context from the whole Clean computation. It does not prove that the channel exclusively represents actions or is the unique Goal mediator.

The protected real future is defined for fixed physical state, complete executed16-control sequence, time and external dynamics. Goal-conditioned observational representations need not obey universal invariance.
Policy candidate controls, original Value Goal, scoring algorithm and candidate-specific randomness remain fixed. Only Future outgoing sender K/V changes; no truth supplied through donor.
The matched proprio control does not match activation magnitude or information. Both are meaningful channels.

Historical utilities are previous original-Goal continuations after forcing the first16 controls: candidate0 fail300, candidate1 success170. No new selected-action execution or continuously swapped recovery.
One posthoc root and two candidates cannot support ASR, population inference, p-values or independent generalization. Layers/tokens are not independent trials.
Visual latent MSE is an encoded actual-consequence error, not physical-state error or task utility. Content/style mediation remains unresolved.
All old failed gates remain: direct text-entry specificity,30-root expansion and fixedK8 coupling. No core security claim follows automatically.
artifacts: Refuse to overwrite output. Save launched protocol/script, summary with exact activity/status, calibration checks, per-condition tensors and tabular metrics, plus hook integrity/cost statistics. Record technical failure separately from a completed negative route gate.
new_edge_justification: The previous test changed the direct text cross-attention entry at action positions using the same recipient query. It explicitly left indirect Goal-to-other-token-to-action paths unresolved. This test instead replaces the post-normalization/post-RoPE outgoing action K/V at every self-attention layer, using a separately captured same-candidate/seed donor. It does not retest or rescue the previous failed gate.
implementation_review: Independent static review before execution; one missing-field assumption fixed before any model load. Scientific panel, intervention and gate unchanged.
